name: Bertini's 8 Mobile Heuristics
author: Enrico Bertini et al.
description: Adapted heuristics for mobile interface evaluation, accounting for small screens, touch interaction, and environmental interruption.

heuristics.title: Visibility of System Status and Losability/Findability
heuristics.description: Provide clear, persistent feedback on system state. Users should always know where they are and be able to find key functions easily despite limited screen space.

heuristics.title: Match Between System and Real World
heuristics.description: Use mobile-native metaphors and gestures that match real-world expectations. Leverage device capabilities (location, camera, motion) naturally.

heuristics.title: Consistency and Mapping
heuristics.description: Maintain consistency with platform conventions (iOS HIG, Material Design). Map physical interactions (swipe, pinch) to logical outcomes predictably.

heuristics.title: Good Ergonomics and Minimalist Design
heuristics.description: Design for thumb-accessible touch targets (min 44px). Minimize clutter and cognitive load on small screens.

heuristics.title: Ease of Input, Screen Readability, and Glanceability
heuristics.description: Minimize text input requirements. Ensure content is readable in various lighting conditions and glanceable for quick information retrieval.

heuristics.title: Flexibility, Efficiency of Use, and Personalization
heuristics.description: Support multiple input methods and shortcuts. Allow personalization of frequently used features and adaptive interfaces.

heuristics.title: Aesthetic, Privacy, and Social Conventions
heuristics.description: Respect privacy norms in public usage contexts. Design for social acceptability and discrete interaction when needed.

heuristics.title: Realistic Error Management
heuristics.description: Handle connectivity loss, interruptions, and battery constraints gracefully. Auto-save state and support recovery from disruptions.
